quarterly_data.signal: June 2026 Bitcoin production and mining update (unaudited): Canaan mined 64 BTC in June and, after operating costs and BTC received as payment for miner sales, added 49 BTC to its treasury (CEO Nangeng Zhang: its strongest monthly increase of 2026). Month-end operating hashrate was 3.36 EH/s non-JV and 4.09 EH/s for the JV (4.81 EH/s installed); North American non-JV fleet efficiency was 17.9 J/TH; installed power capacity was 246.2 MW non-JV globally (88.7 MW in North America, 157.5 MW outside) plus 120 MW at the JV; average revenue split 60.3%. One Ethiopian site was taken offline from mid-June for local grid maintenance, and the JV (49% of the Alborz, Bear and Chief Mountain facilities in West Texas, partner WindHQ) had substantially resumed operating after wildfire-related disruptions at Alborz in May.
